finance_adjustment_reason_check.name: finance_adjustment_reason_check
finance_adjustment_reason_check.value: nullif(btrim("finance_adjustment"."reason_code"), '') is not null and nullif(btrim("finance_adjustment"."reason_note"), '') is not null

finance_adjustment_line_requires_bill_ch.name: finance_adjustment_line_requires_bill_check
finance_adjustment_line_requires_bill_ch.value: "finance_adjustment"."bill_line_id" is null or "finance_adjustment"."bill_id" is not null

finance_bill_run_supplemental_reason_che.name: finance_bill_run_supplemental_reason_check
finance_bill_run_supplemental_reason_che.value: ("finance_bill_run"."kind" = 'supplemental' and nullif(btrim("finance_bill_run"."supplemental_reason"), '') is not null) or ("finance_bill_run"."kind" = 'regular' and "finance_bill_run"."supplemental_reason" is null)

finance_bill_run_finalization_shape_chec.name: finance_bill_run_finalization_shape_check
finance_bill_run_finalization_shape_chec.value: ("finance_bill_run"."status" = 'posting' and "finance_bill_run"."finalized_at" is null) or ("finance_bill_run"."status" = 'posted' and "finance_bill_run"."finalized_at" is not null)

finance_bill_source_shape_check.name: finance_bill_source_shape_check
finance_bill_source_shape_check.value: ("finance_bill"."source_kind" = 'billing_run' and "finance_bill"."bill_run_id" is not null and "finance_bill"."manual_reason" is null) or ("finance_bill"."source_kind" = 'manual' and "finance_bill"."bill_run_id" is null and nullif(btrim("finance_bill"."manual_reason"), '') is not null)

finance_bill_finalization_shape_check.name: finance_bill_finalization_shape_check
finance_bill_finalization_shape_check.value: ("finance_bill"."status" = 'posting' and "finance_bill"."finalized_at" is null) or ("finance_bill"."status" = 'posted' and "finance_bill"."finalized_at" is not null)

finance_ledger_reversal_shape_check.name: finance_ledger_reversal_shape_check
finance_ledger_reversal_shape_check.value: ("finance_ledger_entry"."type" = 'reversal' and "finance_ledger_entry"."reversal_of_entry_id" is not null) or ("finance_ledger_entry"."type" <> 'reversal' and "finance_ledger_entry"."reversal_of_entry_id" is null)

finance_ledger_direction_type_check.name: finance_ledger_direction_type_check
finance_ledger_direction_type_check.value: ("finance_ledger_entry"."type" in ('bill', 'manual_debit_adjustment', 'refund', 'debit_correction') and "finance_ledger_entry"."direction" = 'debit') or ("finance_ledger_entry"."type" in ('payment', 'discount', 'waiver', 'write_off', 'credit_correction') and "finance_ledger_entry"."direction" = 'credit') or "finance_ledger_entry"."type" = 'reversal'

notification_recipient_check.name: notification_recipient_check
notification_recipient_check.value: ("notification"."recipient_kind" = 'staff_user' and "notification"."user_id" is not null and "notification"."admission_id" is null) or ("notification"."recipient_kind" = 'admission' and "notification"."admission_id" is not null and "notification"."user_id" is null)

notification_dismiss_read_check.name: notification_dismiss_read_check
notification_dismiss_read_check.value: "notification"."dismissed_at" is null or "notification"."read_at" is not null
